projectState.summary: The pick-stroke audition MIDI now treats repeated chord strums more like a held fretting-hand shape with right-hand re-articulation: each string sustains until that string is struck again or the chord changes. A new player-feel plan frames future deterministic timing and velocity variation around cognitive load, dexterity load, and endurance. Next likely step is choosing the first implementation slice: right-hand feel timing/energy, or held-shape repick semantics inside the engine.
